title: 耳朵里面有什么
subtitle: 声音要走过三道门
character: wearing a slate blue t-shirt, grey trousers and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, fine ink line drawing with light blue-grey washes, clean thin outlines, restrained palette of slate blue, warm grey and cream, plenty of clean paper

pages.zh:
我用手捂住耳朵，
外面的声音一下子变小了。
松开手，
声音又全回来了。
耳朵里面到底有什么呢？
pages.scene: The little boy stands with both hands cupped over his ears, eyes wide, listening, in a plain room.

pages.zh:
耳朵分成三段：
外面能看见的是外耳，
中间一小格是中耳，
再往里是内耳。
声音要走过这三段。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one ear shown in cross-section on a cream background, divided into three clearly separated parts by two vertical lines, each part a different shade. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
外面那只耳朵，
形状弯弯曲曲的。
它像一个小漏斗，
把四面八方的声音
收进耳朵里。
pages.scene: One ear seen from the side on a cream background, with several curved lines outside it funnelling inward toward the opening. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
耳道走到尽头，
有一张薄薄的皮，
叫「耳膜」。
它薄得像纸，
可是整只耳朵就靠它。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one straight tube on a cream background with a thin taut membrane stretched across its far end. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
声音一来，
耳膜就跟着抖。
声音大，它抖得厉害；
声音小，它只轻轻动一下。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two tubes side by side on a cream background, each with a membrane at the end: the left membrane bulging far out with three wide curves before it, the right one almost flat with one small curve. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
耳膜后面有三块小骨头，
是身上最小的骨头。
它们一个推一个，
把这点儿抖动
放得更大。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: three small bone shapes in a row on a cream background, each touching the next, with one arrow passing along the row from left to right and getting thicker. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
再往里，
有一根卷起来的管子，
像一只蜗牛，
叫耳蜗。
里面装满了水。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one spiral shape on a cream background, coiled two and a half turns like a snail shell. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
耳蜗里长着很多小毛。
水一晃，
小毛就跟着弯。
它们一弯，
就发出信号。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one strip along the bottom of a cream background with many short hairs standing up from it, a wave passing over them, and the hairs under the wave bending to one side. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
信号顺着神经
跑到大脑里。
大脑一听，
才知道那是妈妈的声音，
还是外面的车。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one spiral on the left of a cream background with a thick line running to a simple brain shape on the right, and one arrow along that line. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
那些小毛很娇气。
声音太吵，
会把它们压坏，
而且坏了就长不回来。
所以别把音量开太大。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two strips side by side on a cream background: the left one with straight upright hairs, the right one with several hairs lying flat and broken. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
也别把东西塞进耳朵。
耳屎不用挖，
它会自己慢慢往外走。
耳朵会照顾自己，
不用我们帮忙。
pages.scene: One ear seen from the side on a cream background with a small cotton bud drawn beside it and a bold diagonal line across the cotton bud. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我又捂住耳朵。
这一次，
我听见了自己的心跳。
咚，咚，咚。
原来最近的声音，一直在身体里。
pages.scene: The little boy sits quietly with both hands over his ears, eyes closed, a small smile, listening inward.
